name: Perform Script
description: Performs a script specified from a list or calculated by name.

name: Save a Copy as XML
description: Saves a copy of an open file as an XML representation of the schema, layouts, and scripts.

name: Go to Next Field
description: Moves to the next field in the tab order of the current layout.

name: Go to Previous Field
description: Moves to the previous field in the tab order of the current layout.

name: Go to Layout
description: Switches to the specified layout.

name: New Record/Request
description: Creates a new, blank record or a new find request.

name: Duplicate Record/Request
description: Duplicates the current record or the current find request.

name: Delete Record/Request
description: Deletes the current record or find request.

name: Delete All Records
description: Deletes all the records in the current found set.

name: Insert from Index
description: Pastes a value from the index into a field.

name: Insert from Last Visited
description: Pastes data from the last active record into the specified field in the current record or find request.

name: Insert Current Date
description: Pastes the current system date into a field or variable.

name: Insert Current Time
description: Pastes the current system time into a field or variable.

name: Go to Record/Request/Page
description: Moves to a record or a report page, or displays a find request.

name: Go to Field
description: Moves to the specified field on the current layout.

name: Check Selection
description: Uses the spelling checker to check the selected text.

name: Check Record
description: Uses the spelling checker to check the contents of every field in the current record.

name: Check Found Set
description: Uses the spelling checker to check the contents of every field in the records being browsed.

name: Unsort Records
description: Restores the records in the current found set to the order in which the records were entered.

name: Enter Find Mode
description: Switches to Find mode.

name: Show All Records
description: Finds all records in the table underlying the foreground window and selects the current record.

name: Modify Last Find
description: Changes the most recent find request.

name: Omit Record
description: Omits the current record from the found set, or switches the current find request between finding and omitting records.

name: Omit Multiple Records
description: Omits several records from the found set, starting with the current record, and selects the next record in the table.

name: Show Omitted Only
description: Finds the records not in the current found set.

name: Perform Find
description: Finds records using the current or stored find requests.

name: Show/Hide Toolbars
description: Shows or hides the FileMaker Pro status toolbar and the FileMaker Go toolbar and editing toolbar.

name: View As
description: Displays data in the specified format.

name: Adjust Window
description: Hides or changes the size of a window.

name: Open Help
description: Opens the onscreen Help.

name: Open File
description: Opens a FileMaker Pro file or connects to an ODBC data source.

name: Close File
description: Closes a FileMaker Pro file or disconnects from an ODBC data source.

name: Import Records
description: Imports records from a specified file or data source.

name: Export Records
description: Exports records to a specified file.

name: Save a Copy as
description: Saves a copy of the current file.

name: Open Manage Database
description: Opens the Manage Database dialog box.

name: Sort Records
description: Sorts the records in the current found set according to specified criteria.

name: Relookup Field Contents
description: Copies new values from the lookup source field into the current found set.

name: Enter Preview Mode
description: Switches to Preview mode.

name: Print Setup
description: Sets print options, such as paper size and orientation, which can be stored with this script step.

name: Print
description: Prints information that is in the current FileMaker Pro file.

name: Exit Application
description: Closes all open files; and in FileMaker Pro, exits the application.

name: Undo/Redo
description: Reverses, restores, or switches between the most recently performed actions in the file.

name: Cut
description: Deletes the contents of the specified field in the current record and saves the contents to the Clipboard.

name: Copy
description: Copies the contents of the specified field in the current record and saves the contents to the Clipboard.

name: Paste
description: Pastes the contents of the Clipboard into the specified field in the current record.

name: Clear
description: Deletes the contents of the specified field in the current record.

name: Select All
description: Selects the entire contents of the active field.

name: Revert Record/Request
description: Returns the current record or find request to the way it was before editing began.

name: Enter Browse Mode
description: Switches to Browse mode.

name: Insert Picture
description: Imports a graphic from another file into the current container field.

name: Send Event
description: In Windows, performs an action in another application; in macOS, sends an Apple event to another application.

name: Insert QuickTime
description: Imports a QuickTime movie or sound file into the current container field.

name: Insert Current User Name
description: Pastes the current user name into a field in the current record or into a variable.

name: Insert Text
description: Pastes a text value into a field in the current record or into a variable.

name: Pause/Resume Script
description: Pauses a script so the user can perform other tasks in the current window.

name: Send Mail
description: Sends an email message through an email application or via SMTP.

name: Send DDE Execute
description: Sends a DDE command to another application to execute commands in that application.

name: Dial Phone
description: Dials a phone from within a script.

name: Speak
description: Produces speech from text.

name: Perform AppleScript
description: Sends AppleScript commands to another application.

name: If
description: Evaluates a Boolean calculation and performs a conditional action based on that evaluation.

name: Else
description: Performs an alternate set of script steps when an If or Else If script step evaluates to false.

name: End If
description: Marks the end of an If script step structure.

name: Loop
description: Repeats a set of script steps, to perform batch processes.

name: Exit Loop If
description: Exits a loop if the specified calculation is true (not zero).

name: End Loop
description: Marks the end of a Loop script structure.

name: Go to Related Record
description: Goes to the current related record(s) in a related table.

name: Commit Records/Requests
description: Commits a record or find request.

name: Set Field
description: Replaces the entire contents of the specified field in the current record with a calculation result.

name: Insert Calculated Result
description: Pastes the result of a calculation into the current field in the current record or into a variable.

name: Freeze Window
description: Stops updating the active window.

name: Refresh Window
description: Updates the entire contents of the active window, including any related records.

name: Scroll Window
description: Scrolls a window or layout vertically, or brings the current field into view.

name: New File
description: Opens the Create window so users can create a new FileMaker Pro file.

name: Change Password
description: Changes the password for the current FileMaker file account.

name: Set Multi-User
description: Allows or disallows network access to a file.

name: Allow User Abort
description: Allows or prevents users from stopping a running script.

name: Set Error Capture
description: Suppresses or enables normal alert messages displayed by FileMaker clients.

name: Show Custom Dialog
description: Displays a custom message dialog box, with custom text and labels.

name: Open Script Workspace
description: Opens the Script Workspace.

name: # (comment)
description: Adds comments to the list of steps in the script.

name: Halt Script
description: Forces all scripts, sub-scripts, or external scripts running in the current FileMaker application to stop immediately.

name: Replace Field Contents
description: Replaces the value in a field in every record in the found set with a different value.

name: Show/Hide Text Ruler
description: Shows or hides the text ruler.

name: Beep
description: Plays a system beep sound.

name: Set Use System Formats
description: Sets the formats either to those stored with the file or to the current system formats.

name: Recover File
description: Recovers a damaged FileMaker Pro file.

name: Save a Copy as Add-on Package
description: Creates an add-on package from a FileMaker Pro file.

name: Set Zoom Level
description: Enlarges or reduces the image on the screen.

name: Copy All Records/Requests
description: Copies the values of all records or the search criteria in all find requests to the Clipboard.

name: Go to Portal Row
description: Navigates among the rows in the active portal.

name: Copy Record/Request
description: Copies the values of a record or find request to the Clipboard.

name: Flush Cache to Disk
description: Immediately flushes the internal file cache to the computer's hard disk.

name: Exit Script
description: Forces the running script, sub-script, or external script to stop immediately.

name: Delete Portal Row
description: Deletes the selected portal row.

name: Open Settings
description: Opens the Settings dialog box to the General tab.

name: Correct Word
description: Opens the Spelling dialog box so the user can correct a misspelled word.

name: Spelling Options
description: Opens the File Options dialog box to the Spelling tab.

name: Select Dictionaries
description: Opens the Select Dictionaries dialog box.

name: Edit User Dictionary
description: Opens the User Dictionary dialog box.

name: Open URL
description: Allows the user to open a URL.

name: Open Manage Value Lists
description: Opens the Manage Value Lists dialog box.

name: Open Sharing
description: Opens the FileMaker Network Settings dialog box.

name: Open File Options
description: Opens the File Options dialog box to the Open tab.

name: Allow Formatting Bar
description: Enables or disables display of the formatting bar.

name: Set Next Serial Value
description: Resets the next serial value in an auto-entry serial number field.

name: Execute SQL
description: Executes any SQL statement on an ODBC data source.

name: Open Hosts
description: Opens the Hosts dialog box.

name: Move/Resize Window
description: Adjusts the size or location of the chosen window.

name: Arrange All Windows
description: Adjusts the size and location of all open windows.

name: Close Window
description: Closes the currently active window or any other window by name or UUID.

name: New Window
description: Creates a new window based on the foreground window.

name: Select Window
description: Specifies a window by name or UUID and makes it the foreground window.

name: Set Window Title
description: Changes the title of a window.

name: Else If
description: Evaluates a Boolean calculation and performs a conditional action based on that evaluation, like If.

name: Constrain Found Set
description: Narrows the existing found set using the current or stored find requests.

name: Extend Found Set
description: Broadens the existing found set using the current or stored find requests.

name: Perform Find/Replace
description: Finds/replaces data according to the options in the Perform Find/Replace Options dialog box.

name: Open Find/Replace
description: Opens the Find/Replace dialog box.

name: Set Selection
description: Designates a selection or cursor location in a field.

name: Insert File
description: Imports a file or file reference into the current container field or into a variable; configures the Insert File dialog box.

name: Export Field Contents
description: Exports the contents of a single field in the active record to a new file.

name: Open Record/Request
description: Makes an existing record or find request available for editing if the current user has record-editing privileges.

name: Add Account
description: Adds a new account.

name: Delete Account
description: Deletes an account.

name: Reset Account Password
description: Resets the password of a FileMaker file account.

name: Enable Account
description: Enables or disables an account.

name: Re-Login
description: Signs in again to an open file with a different FileMaker file account, external server account, or the Guest account.

name: Convert File
description: Converts a file in a supported format to a FileMaker Pro file.

name: Open Manage Data Sources
description: Opens the Manage External Data Sources dialog box.

name: Set Variable
description: Sets a local or global variable to a specified value.

name: Install Menu Set
description: Changes the menu set based on conditions established in the script.

name: Save Records as Excel
description: Saves records to a specified Excel worksheet.

name: Save Records as PDF
description: Saves records to a specified PDF file.

name: Go to Object
description: Moves to the specified object on the current layout.

name: Set Web Viewer
description: Controls the specified web viewer.

name: Set Field by Name
description: Replaces the entire contents of a calculated target field in the current record with the calculated value.

name: Install OnTimer Script
description: Runs a specified script at the specified interval.

name: Open Edit Saved Finds
description: Opens the Edit Saved Finds dialog box.

name: Perform Quick Find
description: Performs a quick find based on specified text or on text returned by a calculation.

name: Open Manage Layouts
description: Opens the Manage Layouts dialog box.

name: Save Records as Snapshot Link
description: Saves a found set of records to a FileMaker Pro Snapshot Link (FMPSL) file.

name: Sort Records by Field
description: Sorts the records in the current found set according to the context of a specified field.

name: Find Matching Records
description: Finds records based on the context of a specified field.

name: Open Manage Containers
description: Opens the Manage Containers dialog box.

name: Install Plug-In File
description: Installs or updates a plug-in file from a container field onto your computer.

name: Insert PDF
description: Imports a PDF file or file reference into the current interactive container.

name: Insert Audio/Video
description: Imports an audio or video file, or a file reference, into the current interactive container.

name: Insert from URL
description: Enters the content from a URL into a field or variable.

name: Insert from Device
description: In FileMaker Go, enters content from a device into a field.

name: Perform Script on Server
description: Performs a script specified from a list or calculated by name on the server that is hosting the current file.

name: Open Manage Themes
description: Opens the Manage Themes dialog box.

name: Show/Hide Menubar
description: Shows or hides the menu bar.

name: Refresh Object
description: Updates the contents, conditional formatting, and visibility state of the specified object.

name: Set Layout Object Animation
description: Enables or disables animations while a script is running.

name: Close Popover
description: Closes an open popover in the window in which the script step runs.

name: Open Upload to Host
description: Opens the Upload to Host dialog box.

name: Enable Touch Keyboard
description: Enables or disables the touch keyboard.

name: Perform JavaScript in Web Viewer
description: Performs a JavaScript function in a web viewer.

name: Set Allowed Orientations
description: Controls the orientation of FileMaker Go and layouts displayed in FileMaker Go.

name: AVPlayer Play
description: Plays audio, video, or images from a container field, layout object, or URL.

name: AVPlayer Set Playback State
description: Pauses, resumes, or stops playing a media file that is playing or is paused.

name: AVPlayer Set Options
description: Changes the settings for a media file that is playing or is paused.

name: Refresh Portal
description: Refreshes the relationship and contents of the named object.

name: Get Folder Path
description: Sets a variable to the fully qualified path of a specified folder.

name: Truncate Table
description: Deletes all records in the specified source table regardless of the current found set.

name: Open Favorites
description: Opens the Favorites window.
Open Starter Solution

name: Configure Region Monitor Script
description: Configures a specified script to run when an iOS or iPadOS device enters or exits a specified region.

name: Configure Local Notification
description: Queues or clears a local notification.

name: Get File Exists
description: Returns 1 (true) if a file exists; otherwise, returns 0 (false).

name: Get File Size
description: Returns the size, in bytes, of a file.

name: Create Data File
description: Creates an empty, closed data file, to then open with the Open Data File script step and add data to using the Write to Data File script step.

name: Open Data File
description: Opens a data file for use with other data file script steps.

name: Write to Data File
description: Writes data to an open data file.

name: Read from Data File
description: Reads data from an open data file.

name: Get Data File Position
description: Returns the read-write position in an open data file.

name: Set Data File Position
description: Sets the read-write position in an open data file.

name: Close Data File
description: Closes an open data file.

name: Delete File
description: Deletes a file.

name: Rename File
description: Renames a file.

name: Set Error Logging
description: Controls whether errors are logged while the current file's scripts are running.

name: Configure NFC Reading
description: Scans or stops scanning for NFC (near field communication) tags.

name: Configure Machine Learning Model
description: Loads a Core ML (Machine Learning) model and prepares it for use.

name: Execute FileMaker Data API
description: Executes a FileMaker Data API request.

name: Open Transaction
description: Starts a transaction; subsequent record changes are held in the transaction until a Commit Transaction or Revert Transaction script step is performed.

name: Commit Transaction
description: Saves all record changes and ends the current transaction.

name: Revert Transaction
description: Returns all records changed in the transaction to their original state and ends the current transaction.

name: Set Session Identifier
description: Sets an identifier for the user's current session.

name: Set Dictionary
description: Changes Main Spelling Dictionary and User Spelling dictionary.

name: Perform Script on Server with Callback
description: Performs a script on the server that is hosting the current file without pausing the client and performs the specified callback script on the client when the server script is done.

name: Trigger Claris Connect Flow
description: Triggers a Claris Connect flow and sends the specified JSON data.

name: Configure AI Account
description: Sets up an AI account to use by name, given a model provider (or endpoint) and an API key.

name: Fine-Tune Model
description: Fine-tunes a model with the specified training data set.

name: Perform SQL Query by Natural Language
description: Sends a natural language prompt and database schema to a model, which sends back an SQL query to get a result from the database to use in its response.

name: Insert Embedding
description: Sends input data to an embedding model and inserts the returned vector representation into a field or variable.

name: Insert Embedding in Found Set
description: For every record in the found set, sends data from a source field to an embedding model and inserts the returned vector representation into a target field.

name: Set AI Call Logging
description: Controls whether details of AI calls are saved to a log file.

name: Perform Semantic Find
description: Performs a semantic find in a target field for the specified text, image, or embedding vectors.

name: Perform RAG Action
description: Sends a prompt to, or adds and removes data from, a RAG space on the AI model server specified by a RAG account.

name: Generate Response from Model
description: Gets a text response from an AI model given a user prompt.

name: Perform Find by Natural Language
description: Sends a natural language prompt and a list of fields on the current layout to a model, which returns a FileMaker find request, and performs a find.

name: Configure Regression Model
description: Trains, saves, loads, and unloads a regression model. Trains a model based on embedding vectors for text data and numeric target data.

name: Set Revert Transaction on Error
description: Controls whether transactions are immediately reverted when an error occurs.

name: Execute URL
description: Perform a REST call on an API

name: Save Records as JSONL
description: Saves records to a specified JSONL file.

name: Configure Prompt Template
description: Sets up a prompt template to use by name in other AI script steps, given a model provider and predefined prompts you can customize.

name: Configure RAG Account
description: Sets up a RAG account to use by name, given an endpoint and an API key.

name: Go to List of Records
description: Goes to a layout and returns the found set specified by a list of record IDs.

name: Flush Web Viewer Cookies
description: Immediately flushes all web viewer cookies used in the FileMaker client.

name: Configure Persistent Data
description: Sets or deletes an entry in the persistent data store.

name: Validate Scripts
description: Validate scripts by AI Model

name: Insert Image Captions in Found Set
description: For every record in the found set, sends an image from a source field to an image captioning model and inserts the returned caption into a target field.

name: Insert Image Caption
description: Sends an image to an image captioning model and inserts the returned caption into a field or variable.

name: Print PDF
description: Prints a PDF file from the specified file path, container field, or variable.

name: Create PDF
description: Creates an empty PDF file in memory. Add pages using script steps such as Append PDF, then close and save the file using the Close PDF script step.

name: Append PDF
description: Appends PDF pages to the file opened by the Open PDF script step or created by the Create PDF script step.

name: Close PDF
description: Closes and saves the open PDF file to a file path, variable, or container field.

name: Open PDF
description: Opens a PDF file. Add pages using script steps such as Append PDF, then close and save the file using the Close PDF script step.

name: Cancel PDF
description: Closes the open PDF in memory without saving it.

name: Replace Field Contents by Name
description: Replaces the value in a calculated target field in every record in the found set with a different value.

name: Set Variable by Name
description: Sets a local or global variable with a calculated name to a specified value.
